messages:
alex: Quick sync — I'm proposing we split auth log retention and only export a focused subset to SIEM. Want to avoid sending full success logs off-platform.
maria: +1. can you outline the splits? what will SIEM get vs what stays internal?
kenji: Suggestion: keep auth.success (low value) 30d in hot store, auth.failure & suspicious events 365d and export failures & anomalies to SIEM. Keep raw tokens/headers out.
alex: Exactly. Proposed export filter: only events with outcome != "success" OR risk_score >= 70 OR flagged_by=fraud_engine. SIEM gets enriched events, not raw request bodies.
maria: How do we gate exports? need KMS unwrap + RBAC check. also audit trail for each export.
kenji: Plan: exporter service requires role "siem_exporter" and a ticket id. KMS unwrap for any exported blobs > 1MB. JIT approval flows for ad-hoc exports.
alex: Example retention config (for ops docs):
```
retention: {
  "auth.success": "30d",
  "auth.failure": "365d",
  "auth.suspicious": "365d"
}
export_filter: "outcome != 'success' || risk_score >= 70 || flagged_by != null"
```
maria: Nice. For RBAC, can we reuse existing forensic roles or create a narrow siem_exporter role? I prefer narrow.
kenji: Narrow role + service principal. Approvals require two approvers for ad-hoc exports: security oncall + data-privacy owner.
alex: Also we should redact IP and user_agent unless needed for investigation. Keep PII minimization.
maria: What about automated SIEM stream vs manual exports? different gating.
kenji: Automated stream (alerts only) uses service account with limited scope and pre-approved KMS key. Manual snapshot exports go through JIT with ticket and unwrap audit.
alex: I'll draft a short playbook and PR to infra-config. Will include curl example for requesting an export.
maria: Please add a sanity check: sampling rate for frequent failures to avoid noise.
infra-bot: ticket #SEC-9123 created for "auth-log retention + SIEM export gating" by alex. @maria assigned as reviewer.
kenji: Thanks — tagging @oncall to review the approval flow before PR.
alex: I'll open PR by EOD. If no objections in 24h we can start staging tests. :thumbsup:
